title: Kissed Char-Grilled Apple Flaky Smoky Festive Bowl
description: A festive polish dish featuring apple juice, char-grill-yang with a touch of smokiness, served in a dolsot-stone-bowl without eggs for an egg-free-friendly option.
instructions: Core and slice the apple into wedges. Place them in a mixing bowl with the apple juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Toss gently to combine all ingredients evenly.
Brush the sliced apple wedges lightly with extra virgin olive oil on both sides.
Arrange apple wedges on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown.
While apples are baking, heat the dolsot-stone-bowl over a medium flame until hot.
Top each baked apple wedge with a sprinkle of sea salt and black pepper. Serve immediately in the heated dolsot-stone-bowl.
